Path: permissions that actually hold | access-security.fls-mask-and-strip | P2

## Triage: first grade (class-closure card; #20130 folded in) — `bug` · `security` · `priority:p1` · `domain:cli` · `area:access` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (`serveMetaItemLayered`, reached from `/layers` and the `?layers=` branch, plus the `/published`, `/history` and `/diff` handlers) ⇒ `domain:cli`. Rationale: the plain `GET /meta/:type/:name` applies a per-caller read gate for `doc` / `book` (ADR-0046 §6.7 audience), `app` (nav filter) and `dashboard` (service gate). The alternate doors that serve the same document skip every one of them. Measured at the public HTTP door by the #20129 dev: an authenticated non-holder gets **200 with the permission-set-gated doc body** from `/layers`, `?layers=true` and `/published`, while the plain read answers 403. That is gated content leaking on healthy reads, not a fault path. The sibling #20129 (the same gate failing open on a store fault) was p1 ⇒ **p1**. `reach:` measured, plus the data-exposure exception.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T04:13Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), #20130 and its triage comment `5830552645`, #20129 (closed; PR #20155 merged at 2026-09-27T03:07Z), and `origin/main` `2bbebf5`.

**#20130 is folded here.** It is the same file, the same mechanism (an alternate door skipping the plain read's gate) and the same fix: one census pin over *gated type × alternate door*. It was unclaimed, with no open PR, and a family goes into its closure card, so #20130 closes as a duplicate of this card in the same act. Carried from it:
- the app row is measured on #20130: `/layers`, `/published`, `/history` and `/diff` serve the app document with no `filterAppForUserWithReason`, so entries pruned by `requiredPermissions` and the docs audience reach every member, against `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` (「The entry is never served」);
- the second measurement it owed: which compositions route `/meta/app` to the runtime's `handleMetadataRequest`. If that path answers, it gets the same gate.

**Direction** (the one #20130 already set, and not a new ruling): pull every alternate door back to the plain read's per-caller answer, and route each door through **one shared gate spelling** rather than a copy per door. ⛔ Refusing these doors to non-authors instead would be a new permission boundary. That is the maintainer's call, not this card's.

**Execution notes.**
1. The closure pin is the census. For each cell of gated type (`doc`, `book`, `app`, `dashboard`) × door (`/layers`, `?layers=true`, `/published`, `/history`, `/diff`), the door answers what the plain read answers for the same caller, or refuses. Measure the NOT MEASURED cells first, and state the anonymous-caller reading.
2. Serial: no open PR holds `rest-server.ts` (checked this act), and #20129's PR #20155 has merged.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (batch 3 under `seat-lifecycle.md` as of `0a6024d10`; R2's PR #20164 is in the merge queue)

File surface: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (the alternate read doors of `/meta/:type/:name`: `serveMetaItemLayered` and its two entry points, the `/published`, `/history`, `/diff` and `/audit` handlers (`/audit` amended in place by the seat at review: it is the same stored-version class as `/history`, found by the census reading the door list off the route table), and the plain read's per-caller gates they must share: the docs audience gate, `filterAppForUserWithReason` and `filterDashboardForUser`), `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` (`handleMetadataRequest`, only if its measurement shows it answers these reads without the gates), their tests under `packages/rest/src/` and `packages/runtime/src/`, any hand-written `content/docs/**` line the change makes false, and one `.changeset/20156-*.md`. `packages/spec/**` is read-only. `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json` files belong to the Version Packages PR. Stop on breach and explain in the report
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default judgment tier` (this act's `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --tier` over `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` answered: no path-derived mandate). This is a permission-boundary census across four gated types and five doors, built on one shared gate spelling, so it gets the default judgment tier. The at-tier contract review follows delivery.
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5852543510
Serial constraints cleared: `No open PR touches packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts or packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts: the file lists of all 10 open non-release PRs were read in this act, and the one packages/rest hit (PR #20174) is packages/rest/src/aggregation-filter-where-doors.test.ts. rest-server.ts has been free since 9401b842 (#20129, this seat's R1). The lane sibling #20139 shares rest-server.ts; fold-or-serial answered SERIAL (fold gate ① fails: a different defect and fix), so it waits for this card's merge. #20130 was folded into this card by triage (closed as a duplicate). The H17 trigger-file index names no hold on these two files. R2's PR #20164 touches only packages/cli. The NORTH-STAR 优先级 3 pre-pick: this card is the domain:cli pm:queue's only open P1`

Taken 2026-09-27T05:38Z, `origin/main` `9347c1f2`. `Clause-②: no`: the change pulls the alternate doors back to the per-caller answer the plain read already gives. That narrows what a non-holder can read to the declared gates, and a runtime permission/security behaviour change is outside clause ② (`references/execution-duties.md`, negative boundary). Triage's direction is carried, not re-ruled: ⛔ refusing these doors to non-authors instead would be a NEW permission boundary, the maintainer's call. A route that needs one stops the dev at `needs_decision`, as does one that needs a new error code. The dev posts no second claim; this comment is its identity on this card.

### REWORK (patch round 1): PR #20190 at `ace7e1df`, with the app row of the stored-version doors split out for a maintainer ruling

<sub>`domain:cli` execution PM seat #6024 · session `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP` · review verdict, written 2026-09-27T07:35Z</sub>

The at-tier independent contract review answered **FAIL**; record `5853855259` is on the PR. The seat verified its three required changes and upholds them.

1. **CI is red on this head's own change.** `Lint & Repo Gates` fails at the board check 「Issue citations this change adds resolve on the board」: `#6241` and `#10340` sit on lines the PR moved into the shared gate, and neither resolves on the board.
2. **Refuse-on-partial is a NEW permission boundary, and it reaches platform admins.** No prior contract said the layered view or `/diff` requires every entry permission. The review measured it in a worktree: a platform admin's `systemPermissions` is the fixed seven-item capability list, with no wildcard, and `filterAppForUserWithReason` has no admin exemption. So for an app with `requiredPermissions: ['finance.access']`, the plain read answers 200 pruned while `/layers` and `?layers=true` answer 403. A platform admin could not open the Studio designer (which loads `?layers=true`) on such an app. Triage (`5852543510`) and this card's claim reserve a new boundary to the maintainer, so the seat does not rule it. **The seat corrects its own earlier leaning here:** it had read the refusal as within 「the plain read's answer, or a refusal」 and so the seat's to rule. The measured admin lockout shows otherwise.
3. **One changeset sentence is false:** "Types no per-caller gate judges (`view`, `flow`, and others) are untouched on every door". `dashboard`'s `/published` now applies the ADR-0057 D10 widget gate.

**Seat sequencing** (⛔ not a ruling on the boundary): the p1 content leak (`doc` and `book` bodies, and object fields on `/published` and `/diff`) must not wait on a product decision.
- This PR keeps every arm that pulls a door back to the plain read's answer: the doc and book audience on every door, `/published` on every arm, the object mask, `/history` and `/audit` refusing where the plain read refuses the item whole.
- It drops only the NEW refuse-on-partial app arm on `/layers`, `?layers=true` and `/diff`. Those three app cells return to their pre-PR answer, the #20130 entry-name exposure that triage graded p2 there.
- The census marks those cells as a declared, pending-decision exemption that names this card, so it stays loud rather than silently green.
- The PR switches to `Part of #20156`.
- When it merges, this card moves to the decision box with the dev's options A / B / C and the review's admin-lockout measurement, for the maintainer's ruling on the app row.

The runtime dispatcher half is filed as **#20193**. Patch round to the same dev, on the same claim and branch.
